name: Coconut Milk
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's naturally lactose-free and contains no FODMAPs. Choose unsweetened varieties without added inulin or other FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Choose full-fat canned coconut milk for cooking and baking
Check labels to avoid added sugars, gums, or inulin
Shake or stir well before using as separation is natural
Refrigerated carton versions are more diluted than canned
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of potassium and magnesium
Contains lauric acid with antimicrobial properties
